subject: Budget range validation / next steps (Acme Payments)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Cole <jared@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Discovery recap + budget validation

Thanks again for the time today, Jared — good conversation. As promised, quick recap + a couple of asks to validate budget so we can size a recommended config and procurement path.

Quick recap (from our call):
- Primary use: fraud detection and enrichment for payments disputes (short prompts, average response length ~75 tokens).
- Expected traffic: 200k API requests/month for phase 1; target scale to 1.5M requests over 6 months.
- Auth/data needs: customer PII redaction, VPC deployment preferred for Prod.
- Timeline: pilot in 3–4 weeks; enterprise procurement for Q2.

Cost / sizing asks (what we need from you):
1) Typical tokens per request (prompt + completion). If you don’t have exact, a reasonable avg range is fine.
2) Monthly budget band your procurement org would approve without exec sign-off (e.g., <$5k/mo, $5–25k/mo, $25–100k/mo, >$100k/mo).
3) Any procurement thresholds or PO requirements (single-year FO, minimum contract value, required SOW).

Preliminary unit economics notes (for reference):
- Target list price guidance: $X per 1M tokens in hosted consumption varies based on model family and latency SLOs. With a committed Dedicated pool the effective $/1M tokens can drop materially.
- For your volumes (200k reqs/month at ~200 tokens/request = ~40M tokens/month) we’re typically in the mid-tier pricing band unless you opt for a dedicated capacity commitment.

Next steps I suggest:
- You share the tokens/request estimate and procurement thresholds.
- I’ll send a concise pricing estimate and a draft SOW/statement of work for procurement.

Attachments: Redwood_PRICING_ESTIMATE_v1.pdf (pricing ranges), SOW_draft_Acme.docx (placeholder SOW).

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Jared Cole <jared@acme-payments.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + budget validation

Marissa — thanks for the recap and the clear asks. A few quick answers from our side:

- Tokens per request: our average prompt is ~80 tokens and expected completion ~60 tokens, so ~140 tokens/request is a good working average. We’ll confirm with devs but +/- 20 tokens.
- Current pilot expected volume: 200k requests/month. If pilot goes well, production target ~1.2–1.5M requests/month in 3–6 months.
- Procurement thresholds: anything under $30k/year can be handled by our Product Finance team without exec review. Anything above $30k/yr needs VP approval (slower).
- PO process: we use an internal PO once SOW is signed. Our procurement team prefers a short SOW + standard paperwork.

Would appreciate a sample estimate that shows hosted vs. dedicated pricing bands and the break-even point for committed capacity. Can you put that in the estimate?

Also CC’ing procurement: procurement@acme-payments.com — they’ll be the ones issuing the PO.

—Jared
Jared Cole
Director of Product, Acme Payments

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Cole <jared@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, procurement@acme-payments.com
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Discovery recap + budget validation

Thanks Jared — that’s perfect and very helpful. Based on the 140 tokens/request estimate and your volumes, I’ve put together a concise pricing sketch below (high level; see attached PDF for ranges and assumptions).

Assumptions we used:
- Avg tokens/request: 140
- Pilot: 200k requests/month => ~28M tokens/month
- Prod target: 1.4M requests/month => ~196M tokens/month

High-level pricing sketch (hosted API list / approximate):
- Entry hosted band (no commitment): ~$50–120 per 1M tokens depending on model family and latency SLOs.
- Committed dedicated: with a 6–12 month reserved capacity commit we commonly see effective unit cost drop to ~$15–40 per 1M tokens (model dependent).

Estimated monthly spend bands for Acme (by scenario):
- Pilot (hosted, no commit): 28M tokens => ~$1.4k–$3.4k/month.
- Pilot (dedicated reserved micro-pool): 28M tokens => likely $600–$1,120/month effective after commitment credits.
- Prod (hosted, no commit): 196M tokens => ~$9.8k–$23.5k/month.
- Prod (dedicated w/commit): 196M tokens => ~$2.9k–$7.8k/month.

Implication vs procurement threshold: your note that anything under $30k/year (~$2.5k/month) avoids exec review is helpful. Based on the numbers above:
- A hosted prod scenario at 196M tokens/month would likely be above the $30k/year threshold (it could be ~120k–280k/year depending on model).
- A dedicated reserved commitment (6–12 months) pushes Acme comfortably below that threshold in many model/commit combinations.

Actionable next steps I propose:
1) I’ll send an updated pricing estimate that shows a clear hosted vs dedicated comparison with a 6- and 12-month commit line (attached PDF shows initial ranges).
2) Draft SOW: I’ll share a short SOW that matches your pilot scope so procurement can review.
3) Can procurement confirm preferred PO terms (billing cadence, invoicing contact, whether Acme requires specific insurance language)?

If procurement prefers, we can also prepare a one-page executive summary that frames the cost impact vs. the $30k/year threshold to speed approvals. Happy to jump on a short call with Procurement if helpful.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the updated estimate later today.

Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
